p10_b1.ocr: The second table presents the composition of various lignin types with their respective percentages of Carbon (C), Hydrogen (H), Nitrogen (N), and Degree of Unsaturation. [Mim][Ac]-K. lignin holds 63.5% C, 6.0% H, 3.7% N, and a degree of unsaturation of 3.
